pieces.title: How it works, step by step
pieces.purpose: Answers 'I'm not confident with apps' and 'what is the process?' by naming every real step from phone sign-in to approval, so nothing in the application surprises them.

slides.headline: Craves home chef avvadaniki 5 steps
slides.gloss: Headline: 5 steps to become a Craves home chef.

slides.headline: Phone number tho sign in, email verify
slides.body: Mee phone ki OTP vastundi. Mee email ki kuda oka code vastundi.
slides.footnote: You must be 18 or older to apply.
slides.gloss: Headline: Sign in with your phone number, verify your email. Body: You get an OTP on your phone. You get a code on your email too.

slides.headline: Mee kitchen address, rendu kitchen photos
slides.body: Address application lone ivvandi, DM lo kaadu. Mee kitchen nunchi pickup arrange cheyyadaniki Craves daanni vaadutundi.
slides.gloss: Headline: Your kitchen address, two kitchen photos. Body: Give your address only inside the application, not in DMs. Craves uses it to arrange pickup from your kitchen.

slides.headline: ID proof, 14-digit FSSAI number
slides.body: ID: Aadhaar, PAN, bank statement leda vere government ID. FSSAI inka lekapothe, application lo 'Don't have FSSAI?' guide, 'Request a call from Craves' unnayi.
slides.footnote: Your progress is saved, so you can finish later.
slides.gloss: Body: ID: Aadhaar, PAN, a bank statement or another government ID. No FSSAI yet? The application has a 'Don't have FSSAI?' guide and 'Request a call from Craves'.

slides.headline: Craves team mee application review chestundi
slides.body: Every Craves home chef goes through an application and document review before their kitchen can list food.
slides.gloss: Headline: The Craves team reviews your application.

slides.headline: Mee menu, mee prices set cheyyandi
slides.body: Menu items add chesi, prati dish ki mee price pettandi. Craves home chef ga approve ayyaka, Craves meeku packaging materials free ga pampistundi.
slides.gloss: Kicker: Step 5: once approved. Headline: Set your menu and your prices. Body: Add your menu items and put your price on every dish. Once you're approved as a Craves home chef, Craves sends you packaging materials, free.

slides.headline: Link kavala? CHEF ani comment cheyyandi
slides.body: Customers kosam Craves launching soon. Chefs mundu join avutunnaru, so ippude mee kitchen set up cheskondi.
slides.gloss: Headline: Want the link? Comment CHEF. Body: Craves is launching soon for customers. Chefs are joining first, so set up your kitchen now.

pieces.title: FSSAI 2026: what changed for home cooks
pieces.purpose: Answers the biggest worry, FSSAI, with FSSAI's own 2026 rule changes and the help inside the Craves application, so the one item a cook may not have stops being a reason not to start.

slides.headline: FSSAI 2026: home cooks ki em maarindi?
slides.gloss: Headline: FSSAI 2026: what changed for home cooks?

slides.headline: Rs 1.5 crore turnover varaku: registration saripotundi
slides.body: FSSAI says: idi registration, licence kaadu. Inthaku mundu ee limit Rs 12 lakh turnover.
slides.gloss: Kicker: From 1 Apr 2026. Headline: Up to Rs 1.5 crore turnover: registration is enough. Body: FSSAI says: this is registration, not a licence. Before, this limit was Rs 12 lakh turnover.

slides.headline: Registration ki ika renewal avasaram ledu
slides.body: FSSAI says registrations now have perpetual validity, no periodic renewal.
slides.gloss: Headline: Registration no longer needs renewal.

slides.headline: Annual fee matram inka undi
slides.body: Steps, current fee foscos.fssai.gov.in lo chudandi. Old fee numbers nammakandi.
slides.gloss: Kicker: Remember. Headline: The annual fee still applies. Body: Check the steps and the current fee on foscos.fssai.gov.in. Don't trust old fee numbers.

slides.headline: Mee 14-digit FSSAI number
slides.body: Craves application submit cheyyadaniki aa number kavali. Adi vachche lopu application start chesi save cheyyochu.
slides.footnote: Your progress is saved, so you can finish later.
slides.gloss: Kicker: What Craves needs. Headline: Your 14-digit FSSAI number. Body: You need that number to submit your Craves application. Until it comes, you can start the application and save it.

slides.body: Craves application lo 'Don't have FSSAI?' guide, 'Request a call from Craves' unnayi.
slides.gloss: Kicker: Need help with FSSAI? Body: The Craves application has a 'Don't have FSSAI?' guide and 'Request a call from Craves'.

pieces.title: FAQ: six questions home chefs ask
pieces.purpose: Clears the six most common doubts (FSSAI, delivery, payment, packaging, orders, review time) with the approved answers, so a cook can decide without waiting for a DM.

slides.headline: Naaku FSSAI kavala?

slides.footnote: Steps and the current fee: foscos.fssai.gov.in
slides.gloss: Headline: Do I need FSSAI? Body: Yes, you need a 14-digit FSSAI number to submit. Meanwhile you can start the application and save it.

slides.headline: Delivery evaru chestaru?
